This looks great — you've picked up everything I asked about. Reading through it:

- Pasting a link and having the title, description, site icon, and preview image pulled in automatically, with me able to change any of it — yes, that's exactly it, and I like that a slow or unreachable page still lets me save.
- The separate Read Later queue that's independent of favorites — right.
- Archiving that tucks things away reversibly, with delete staying the permanent one — good.
- Selecting several at once, or everything matching my current search, and acting on them all — yes.
- The richer search with `#tag`, exact phrases in quotes, and and/or/not — and tag suggestions as I type — good.
- The longer formatted note — good.
- Saving a search to come back to later — yes.
- Tags being the main way I organize with collections as an optional extra — that's the balance I wanted.

I'm happy with this version of the specification. Please go ahead and prepare the implementation plan.

One small note just so it isn't lost for later: down the road I'll want to bring in bookmarks I already have from my browser and get them back out again, and possibly keep a saved copy of a page's contents — but I'm fine leaving those out of this first version as you've noted.

Approved — go ahead to the planning step.
